# Interlace Design System — component registry

> 140 installable React components served over the shadcn registry protocol. Every item publishes its contract — the React Server Component boundary, a declared minimum viewport, the keyboard path, the state union it models, and its own semver — so a machine can choose a component on facts instead of on a screenshot.

Install copies source into the consumer tree; there is no runtime package to depend on. MIT. Built on Base UI and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Install

```bash
# any item, by absolute URL — always works
npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/button.json

# the CSS baseline every component assumes (pulled automatically as a
# registry dependency, but install it first for a bare project)
npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/theme.json
```

The `@interlace/<name>` short form also works, but only after the namespace is registered in the consumer's `components.json`. Prefer the absolute URL in generated instructions.

## Machine-readable index

- [https://ds.interlace.tools/data/agent-index.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/data/agent-index.json): every item with its full contract — tier, rendering boundary, minViewport, keyboard evidence, state unions, ARIA, exports, versions, dependency graph and install command. Start here; it is the only file that lets you FILTER.
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/r/registry.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/r/registry.json): the shadcn registry index (the format the CLI reads).
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/r/{name}.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/r/button.json): one shadcn registry item — full file contents, targets, dependencies.
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): what an agent can do here, as skills.
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/data/story-map.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/data/story-map.json): item → Storybook story ids, for a live render of any documented state.
- [https://ds.interlace.tools/data/changelog.json](https://ds.interlace.tools/data/changelog.json): release history, per component.

## How to choose a component

Filter `agent-index.json` on the contract, not on the name. The fields that decide whether an item can be used at all:

- `meta.tier` — Which DS layer the item belongs to: theme, lib, primitive, pattern, template, effects, charts. Composition runs upward only — a primitive never imports a pattern.
- `meta.client` — true when the installed file carries the "use client" directive. false means it is safe inside a React Server Component with no boundary.
- `meta.minViewport` — The narrowest viewport in CSS px this component is designed to render correctly at, declared in source as `export const MIN_VIEWPORT`. null means it inherits the min-viewport of whatever it renders and introduces no floor of its own.
- `meta.loading` — true when the component accepts `loading?: boolean` and renders its own skeleton — the DS-wide opt-in, so a caller never hand-rolls a placeholder.
- `meta.version` — The component's own semver, derived from its git history and stamped into the banner of the file you install.
- `meta.since` — The @interlace/ui release the component first shipped in.
- `meta.deprecated` — Present only when the item is on its way out. Carries `removedIn` (a real release, never "eventually") and `replacement`.
- `keyboard` — Observed evidence only. `baseUi` names the Base UI primitive that owns focus and dismissal; `keys` lists the UI Events key values this file branches on itself; `handled` is the disjunction. An item with handled:false is not asserted to be inaccessible — it is asserted to add no keyboard behaviour of its own.
- `states` — The string unions a caller has to satisfy, read from the source. Where a union is a precedence ladder (DATA_STATES) the array order IS the precedence, lowest index wins.
- `a11y` — ARIA roles and attributes written literally in the shipped file, what drives its motion (a CSS driver is clamped by our preflight; a JS driver is out of reach of it), whether the file references prefers-reduced-motion at all, and whether it opts into the WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13 focus ring.

Current distribution across the catalogue:

- rendering: 79 server, 61 client
- keyboard: 106 none, 34 handled
- built-in loading state: 31 of 140
- declared minViewport: 82 at 320, 7 at 480, 1 at 768, 50 at inherited

## Taxonomy

Two axes, both on every item. **Tier** is the DS layer (composition runs upward only). **Category** is intent.

- tier `primitive` — 64 item(s)
- tier `pattern` — 30 item(s)
- tier `effect` — 17 item(s)
- tier `template` — 13 item(s)
- tier `chart` — 7 item(s)
- tier `util` — 5 item(s)
- tier `starter` — 3 item(s)
- tier `theme` — 1 item(s)

- category `primitive` (Primitives) — 64 item(s)
- category `pattern` (Patterns) — 30 item(s)
- category `blog` (Blog & long-form) — 22 item(s)
- category `decorative` (Decorative) — 21 item(s)
- category `foundation` (Foundation) — 20 item(s)
- category `data` (Data display) — 19 item(s)
- category `effect` (Effects) — 17 item(s)
- category `form` (Form & input) — 16 item(s)
- category `template` (Templates) — 13 item(s)
- category `feedback` (Feedback) — 11 item(s)
- category `navigation` (Navigation) — 9 item(s)
- category `overlay` (Overlay) — 9 item(s)
- category `marketing` (Marketing) — 9 item(s)
- category `chart` (Charts) — 7 item(s)
- category `util` (Utilities) — 5 item(s)
- category `a11y` (A11y) — 4 item(s)
- category `starter` (Starters) — 3 item(s)
- category `theme` (Theme) — 1 item(s)

## Items — tier `theme`

- [Interlace Theme](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/theme): @interlace/ui — full DS CSS baseline: tokens, foundation (type/spacing/radius), preflight (focus ring + min-viewport contract), shadcn↔fumadocs bridge, and brand palette.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/theme.json`
  - contract: server, v1.8.0

## Items — tier `primitive`

- [Accordion](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/accordion): A disclosure stack: a column of headers whose panels open and close. Wraps @base-ui/react/accordion — Base UI owns the open state (single or multiple), the keyboard model and every piece of the accordion ARIA.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/accordion.json`
  - contract: client, min 320px, keyboard via Base UI accordion, v1.2.0
- [Alert](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/alert): A bordered in-page message with `role="alert"`, an optional leading icon, a title and a description, in two tones (default and destructive).
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/alert.json`
  - contract: server, v1.1.0
- [Alert Dialog](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/alert-dialog): A modal confirmation dialog for *destructive or otherwise consequential* actions ("Delete project", "Sign out everywhere"). Distinct from `Dialog`: the underlying Base UI primitive disables outside-click and Escape-only dismissal so the user MUST…
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/alert-dialog.json`
  - contract: client, min 320px, keyboard via Base UI alert-dialog, v1.1.0
- [Aspect Ratio](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/aspect-ratio): A single block-level wrapper that reserves space by ratio (CSS `aspect-ratio`) and stretches to the parent's width. Use it as the *frame* for media that arrives async — images, video, embeds, charts — so the surrounding layout never shifts…
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/aspect-ratio.json`
  - contract: server, min 320px, v1.1.0
- [Avatar](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/avatar): A circular image with a text fallback. Wraps @base-ui/react/avatar: Base UI owns the image load/error state machine that decides when the fallback shows, and we own the surface.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/avatar.json`
  - contract: client, loading state, keyboard via Base UI avatar, v1.2.0
- [Badge](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/badge): A small pill for a status, a count, a label or a tag. Renders a `<span>` by default, or whatever Base UI's `render` prop is given, so the same badge can be an anchor without losing its shape.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/badge.json`
  - contract: server, loading state, keyboard via Base UI use-render, v1.3.0
- [Box](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/box): The lowest-altitude layout primitive: surface + box-model on one element. Mirrors MUI `<Box>` (a polymorphic, unopinionated wrapper) minus the `sx` CSS-in-JS prop — Interlace uses a curated, tokenized cva variant set instead, so it cannot reopen the…
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/box.json`
  - contract: server, v1.1.0
- [Breadcrumb](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/breadcrumb): A server-rendered, semantically-tagged trail of ancestor links. The compositional API mirrors the shadcn surface so consumers swap drop-in, and `BreadcrumbLink` keeps a server-safe `asChild` seam (`React.cloneElement`, NOT Base UI `useRender`) so the whole…
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/breadcrumb.json`
  - contract: server, min 480px, v1.1.0
- [Button](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/button): The minimal-surface counterpart to [dialog.tsx](./dialog.tsx). Where Dialog exercises compound composition + portal + focus, Button exercises the variant + render-prop polymorphism + native-event passthrough surface.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/button.json`
  - contract: client, keyboard via Base UI use-render, v1.3.0
- [Button Variants](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/button-variants): The cva variant map that `button.tsx` imports — variant × size class strings and nothing else. Pure CVA: no React, no client APIs, so a server component can style a plain `<a>` with `buttonVariants({ variant, size })`.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/button-variants.json`
  - contract: server, v1.3.0
- [Callout](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/callout): Inline-prose annotation. The "stop and read this" surface that punctuates long-form content (docs, MDX, READMEs). Distinct from `Alert` — Alert is an out-of-band runtime banner ("your save failed"), Callout is an in-band authored aside ("note: this rule is…

- [Card](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/card): A bordered, rounded content surface with header / title / description / action / content / footer parts. The surface, radius and border come from `Box`; the card owns only its column layout, its padding and its shadow.

  - contract: server, min 320px, states rect|circle|text|paragraph|avatar|badge|breadcrumb|button|card|code-block|input|menu|pagination|prose|tabs|tag|toc|checkbox|form|label|number-field|radio-group|select|slider|switch|textarea|article-card|author-byline|data-table|newsletter-form|page-header|prev-next-post|stat-card|chart|metric-table|sparkline|meter|stat-strip, v1.8.0
- [Skeleton Variants](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/skeleton-variants): Single source of truth for the `<Skeleton variant>` discriminated union. Every entry maps to a Tailwind shape class set that paints a placeholder matching the corresponding primitive / pattern / template.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/skeleton-variants.json`
  - contract: server, states rect|circle|text|paragraph|avatar|badge|breadcrumb|button|card|code-block|input|menu|pagination|prose|tabs|tag|toc|checkbox|form|label|number-field|radio-group|select|slider|switch|textarea|article-card|author-byline|data-table|newsletter-form|page-header|prev-next-post|stat-card|chart|metric-table|sparkline|meter|stat-strip, v1.7.0
- [Skip Link](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/skip-link): The "jump to main content" link that satisfies WCAG 2.4.1 (Bypass Blocks): an `sr-only` anchor that pops into the top-left corner the moment it takes focus, letting a keyboard user step past the header and nav in one Tab.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/skip-link.json`
  - contract: server, min 320px, v1.1.0
- [Slider](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/slider): Range / value-picker primitive on top of @base-ui/react/slider. Compositional API: Slider.Root + Track + Indicator + Thumb. Re-exports the DS-styled surface (rail, fill, thumb) without owning state — Base UI handles keyboard (Arrow / Home / End / PageUp /…
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/slider.json`

- [Stack](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/stack): Flex layout whose gap comes from the DS six-step spacing scale, not from a number at the call site (LAYOUT_PHILOSOPHY.md §3). `Stack` stacks children vertically; `Cluster` is the horizontal, wrapping form for chip, tag and button rows.

- [Switch](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/switch): Binary on/off control with immediate effect (no submit step) — the distinction from Checkbox, which collects a value for a form. Built on @base-ui/react/switch: Base UI owns `role="switch"`, `aria-checked`, Space/Enter activation and the…

- [Tabs](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/tabs): A tab bar and its panels. Wraps @base-ui/react/tabs: Base UI owns which tab is selected, arrow-key roving focus and the tablist/tab/tabpanel ARIA; we own the muted pill list and the raised face of the selected tab.

## Items — tier `chart`

- [Delta](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/delta): "It moved, this much, this way." The smallest complete unit of analysis and the most-repeated element in a dense view, so it is worth getting exactly right once.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/delta.json`
  - contract: server, min 320px, states publish|release|action, v1.1.0
- [Distribution](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/distribution): One quantity spread across a fixed set of bins — hours of the day, days of the week, cohorts, buckets — with an optional REFERENCE distribution drawn over it.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/distribution.json`
  - contract: client, min 320px, loading state, keys ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/End/Escape/Home, states publish|release|action, v1.1.0
- [Metric Table](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/metric-table): The roic.ai row: metric name, values across time, sparkline, delta. Click a row to promote it into whatever chart the caller renders above.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/metric-table.json`
  - contract: client, min 320px, loading state, states publish|release|action, v1.2.0
- [Network Graph](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/network-graph): Who is connected to whom, and who the network converges on.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/network-graph.json`
  - contract: client, min 320px, loading state, keys ArrowDown/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/ArrowUp/End/Enter/Escape/Home/Space, v1.1.2
- [Series Table](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/series-table): The data behind a chart, as a real `<table>`.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/series-table.json`
  - contract: server, min 320px, states publish|release|action, v1.1.0
- [Sparkline](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/sparkline): A trend in the width of a table cell. The densest thing in the package: it exists so a `MetricTable` row can show *shape* without spending a chart's worth of pixels, which is the whole roic.ai lesson — one row that reads a decade beats one chart that reads…
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/sparkline.json`
  - contract: server, min 320px, loading state, states publish|release|action, v1.2.0
- [Time Series](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/time-series): One metric over time, with the actions that moved it drawn ON the curve.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/time-series.json`
  - contract: client, min 320px, loading state, keys ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/End/Escape/Home, states publish|release|action, v1.2.0

## Items — tier `effect`

- [Animated Gradient Text](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/animated-gradient-text): Gradient-filled text: a `bg-clip-text text-transparent` span whose three-stop linear gradient slides horizontally on a loop. Built for a short eyebrow, badge or headline fragment — never a paragraph, since the text has no solid fill to fall back to.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/animated-gradient-text.json`
  - contract: server, v1.1.0
- [Animated Grid Pattern](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/animated-grid-pattern): A tiled SVG grid where a handful of cells softly pulse in and out, then teleport to a new random cell on each cycle — a "breathing" graph-paper backdrop for heroes and section bands. Re-authored from the MagicUI pattern to the Interlace component floor.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/animated-grid-pattern.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Animated List](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/animated-list): A feed that reveals its children one at a time, newest on top, each entry springing in from `scale: 0`. One more appears every `delay` ms (1000 by default) until the list is full, then it stops — or restarts, with `loop`.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/animated-list.json`
  - contract: client, v1.2.0
- [Background Beams With Collision](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/background-beams-with-collision): A hero surface where thin vertical beams fall from the top and burst into a ten-particle explosion when they reach the strip along the bottom. Your children render above them on a `z-10` layer.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/background-beams-with-collision.json`
  - contract: client, v1.2.0
- [Background Gradient Animation](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/background-gradient-animation): The "lava lamp" surface: five radial-gradient blobs orbiting behind an SVG goo filter and a 40px blur, over a two-stop gradient backdrop, plus a sixth blob that eases toward the pointer.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/background-gradient-animation.json`
  - contract: client, v1.2.0
- [Background Lines](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/background-lines): A full-bleed backdrop of twelve long, sweeping SVG curves that draw themselves in and fade out on a loop, each staggered by a fixed delay so the field never pulses in unison.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/background-lines.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Border Beam](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/border-beam): A single gradient square that travels around the inside edge of its parent, drawn with `offset-path` and a two-layer CSS mask so only the border ring shows. Drop it inside any `relative`, rounded container to give that container a moving outline.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/border-beam.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Cloud Particles](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/cloud-particles): Volumetric drifting clouds as a decorative backdrop. Each cloud is a radial-gradient ellipse pushed through a five-pass SVG turbulence filter — body, cool underside, soft shadow, deep shadow — and translated across `130vw`.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/cloud-particles.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Flip Words](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/flip-words): A headline word that flips through a list. Each replacement enters letter-by-letter out of an 8px blur while the outgoing one drifts up, blurs and scales away.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/flip-words.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Focus Cards](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/focus-cards): A grid that spotlights one card at a time: pointing at or keyboard-focusing a card keeps it sharp while every sibling dims and blurs. Real list semantics — `ul` › `li` › `article` — and a controlled or uncontrolled active index.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/focus-cards.json`
  - contract: client, v1.2.0
- [Marquee](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/marquee): An infinitely scrolling strip: it renders its children `repeat` times side by side (or stacked, with `vertical`) inside an `overflow-hidden` track and translates each copy by its own width plus the gap, so the row reads as continuous.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/marquee.json`
  - contract: client, v1.2.0
- [Number Ticker](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/number-ticker): A count-up number that starts when it scrolls into view and eases to `value`. It does nothing by default: `startValue` defaults to `value`, so you get an honest static number — and an honest SSR render — until you pass a lower one to opt into the count.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/number-ticker.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Particles](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/particles): An ambient `<canvas>` particle field for hero and section backdrops: `quantity` dots (100 by default) drifting on their own velocities, fading in near the middle and out near the edges, respawned whenever one leaves the box.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/particles.json`
  - contract: client, v1.2.0
- [Shimmer Button](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/shimmer-button): A dark pill CTA with a conic-gradient spark that sweeps around its edge: a rotating cone inside a sliding container, masked by an inset panel that redraws the fill and leaves only the rim glowing.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/shimmer-button.json`
  - contract: server, v1.1.0
- [Spotlight](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/spotlight): The soft, angled glow that fades in behind hero copy: one rotated ellipse under a 151-unit Gaussian blur, absolutely positioned and sized as a percentage of its container. `fill` defaults to `currentColor`, so a text-colour class on the parent tints it.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/spotlight.json`
  - contract: client, v1.2.0
- [Stars Background](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/stars-background): Three night-sky layers you stack behind hero content: `StarsBackground`, a canvas of density-seeded twinkling stars; `ShootingStars`, one SVG streak at a time; and `Meteors`, CSS-animated tails falling at a fixed 215°.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/stars-background.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [Sunny Background](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/sunny-background): A daylight sky you drop behind hero or section content: a two-stop sky gradient with a haze wash, a sun disc (corona → glow → overexposed core → slowly rotating conic rays → four lens flares), a golden-hour horizon band and a depth vignette.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/sunny-background.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0

## Items — tier `starter`

- [A11y Starter](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/a11y-starter): @interlace/ui — the three a11y primitives + the reduced-motion hook every consumer should install on day one.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/a11y-starter.json`
  - contract: server, v1.7.3
- [Layout Starter](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/layout-starter): @interlace/ui — the six layout primitives that compose every page. One install, the LAYOUT_PHILOSOPHY contract is satisfied.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/layout-starter.json`
  - contract: server, v1.7.3
- [MDX Starter](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/mdx-starter): @interlace/ui — the components most MDX pipelines need (Callout, Prose, CodeBlock, Tag), wired through a default mdx-components.tsx.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/mdx-starter.json`
  - contract: server, v1.7.3

## Items — tier `util`

- [cn — class-name merge utility](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/cn): @interlace/ui — the cn() helper, alias-compatible with shadcn. Merges Tailwind class lists deterministically.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/cn.json`
  - contract: server, states h1|h2|h3|h4|h5|h6|body|long|ui|ui-sm|caption|code, v1.1.0
- [No-flash theme bootstrap script](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/theme-script): @interlace/ui — the inline `<head>` script that applies the stored theme before first paint. Without it every page load flashes the default theme.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/theme-script.json`
  - contract: server, v1.0.1
- [Theme token manifest](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/theme-tokens): @interlace/ui — the registry of themes and the list of every `--interlace-*` token a theme must define. A missing token does not throw; it silently inherits the previous theme's value.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/theme-tokens.json`
  - contract: server, states primary|primary-hover|primary-active|primary-foreground|primary-subtle|primary-subtle-foreground|background|foreground|card|card-foreground|popover|popover-foreground|muted|muted-foreground|border|input|ring|accent|accent-foreground|secondary|secondary-foreground|destructive|destructive-foreground|success|success-foreground|warning|warning-foreground|info|info-foreground|caution|caution-foreground|scrim|scrim-foreground|hero-star|hero-trail|hero-meteor|hero-surface|hero-surface-deep|hero-foreground|window-control-close|window-control-minimize|window-control-zoom|chart-1|chart-2|chart-3|chart-4|chart-5|viz-grid|viz-axis|viz-edge|radius-sm|radius-md|radius-lg|brand-mark-bar-o|brand-mark-bar-g, v1.0.0
- [useReducedMotion hook](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/use-reduced-motion): @interlace/ui — the `useReducedMotion` hook every interactive primitive uses to gate animations on the user's OS preference.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/use-reduced-motion.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
- [useTheme hook](https://ds.interlace.tools/c/use-theme): @interlace/ui — reads and writes the theme (`data-theme`) and colour scheme (`.dark`) axes, persists to localStorage, and follows the OS when no preference is stored.
  - install: `npx shadcn@latest add https://ds.interlace.tools/r/use-theme.json`
  - contract: client, v1.1.0
